prompt645_model_capabilities.project_intent: project_id (slug), project_name, goal, success_criteria, constraints, allowed_task_kinds (subset of SUPPORTED_TASK_KINDS), safety_limits (max_tasks/max_cycles_per_task/max_total_seconds hard-bounded by daemon caps 5/2/1800), human_approval_policy (require_human_approval + approval_required_for risk categories), repo_target, completion_criteria placeholder, provenance/audit (schema_version/created_by/source/notes); non-raising validate_project_intent + JSON serialization/round-trip.
prompt645_model_capabilities.project_plan: embeds a validated intent + ordered planned tasks (task_id slug+unique, kind in intent.allowed_task_kinds, task_spec_payload OR generated_task_spec_ref, depends_on, order, status in PLANNED_TASK_STATUSES, generated_task_spec_path), completion_criteria placeholder, provenance; validation rejects duplicate ids, dependency cycles, dangling deps, self-deps, unsupported/not-allowed kinds, task count over safety_limits.max_tasks; JSON serialization/round-trip.
prompt645_model_capabilities.conversion_helper: planned_task_to_task_spec(): pure offline conversion of a planned task into the daemon task-spec dict shape (with optional overrides), no I/O and no enqueue; output accepted by task_spec.validate_task_spec.
